resource.description: This value set includes LOINC terms that can be sent by a payer as part of an HL7 attachment request for additional information. This set includes 1) the preferred (generic) document codes that have clinically-relevant HL7 implementation guides, and 2) the HL7 Attachments Work Group -approved document codes that don't yet have an implementation guide.

resource.title: Valid HL7 Attachment Responses

valueCodeableConcept.text: Responses to requests for additional information

resource.description:
This value set includes LOINC terms that can be sent by a provider in response to a request for additional information from a payer. These LOINC terms are approved by the HL7 Attachments Work Group, and organized into two groups via the attribute in the LOINC Table called HL7_ATTACHMENT_STRUCTURE. This attribute will be populated with a value of "IG exists" (previously STRUCTURED) or "No IG exists" (previously UNSTRUCTURED) for relevant terms. The "IG exists" terms are those that have clinically-relevant HL7 implementation guides that use the U.S. Realm Header. The "No IG exists" terms are those approved by the HL7 AWG for transmission using the Unstructured Document template of the C-CDA.

This valueset is the superset of both the "IG exists" and the "No IG exists" terms, and thus contains all LOINC terms approved for use as an attachment response.

resource.title: LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook Core
resource.description: The LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook is the product of a collaboration between the RSNA and Regenstrief Institute, Inc. to develop a unified model for naming radiology procedures. The "Core" Playbook represents a subset of the Playbook believed to be a more tractable starting point for use of the LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook terms. This "core" set was developed based on the set of terms used at one large academic medical center; it may not cover all of the exams performed at other sites.

valueCodeableConcept.text: Responses to requests for additional information

resource.description: This value set includes a particular collection of LOINC terms that can be sent by a provider in response to a request for additional information from a payer. Within the LOINC Table is an attribute called HL7_ATTACHMENT_STRUCTURE. This attribute will be populated with a value of "IG exists" (previously STRUCTURED) or "No IG exists" (previously UNSTRUCTURED) for relevant terms. This value set contains all terms populated with "No IG exists". The "No IG exists" terms are those approved by the HL7 Attachments Work Group for transmission using the Unstructured Document template of the C-CDA.

resource.title: Functional status, most dependent, and goal terms
resource.description: This value set contains LOINC terms representing functional status. The current version is based on the subset of the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services’ Standardized Patient Assessment Data Elements (SPADEs) that are related to functional status, but may be expanded over time to include concepts beyond the SPADEs. It includes terms that represent current functional ability, most dependent functional ability in the past month, and functional goals. Although these terms are currently only included in LOINC panels representing long-term post-acute care (LT-PAC) assessments, the terms may be used beyond the LT-PAC context.
